description: Plays a chord chart as an MPX stream and also as ordinary pitch voltages, so the harmony can drive modules that have no MPX input

params.text: Sets the tempo when no clock is patched, 30 to 300 beats per minute. With a clock patched it shows the tempo measured from the clock
Returns the chart to its first bar
Chooses how the chord symbols are written, letter names or Roman numerals
Sets the seed the chart's random choices are made from, 0 to 999, so a performance can be repeated exactly
How hard the music swings, from an even division to the full amount players use at this tempo. It travels on the cable, so everything playing against this chart divides the beat the same way
Records the whole chain: every module downstream that keeps a log starts its log when this is lit and stops it when it goes out
The style of the whole chain, passed down the cable. Choosing one sets mpxPhrase to that style's rhythm and each melody voice to its line; a bass or inner voice keeps its own. Click for the list

inputs.text: Advances the chart; patching anything here overrides the tempo knob
Returns the chart to its first bar

outputs.text: Carries the chart's chords on as an MPX stream
Carries the tones of the chord in force as polyphonic pitch, one channel per tone
Carries the root of the chord in force as a pitch voltage
Carries a bass line beneath the chord as a pitch voltage

notes: a new module has no chart in it and plays nothing; a song has to be chosen, and songs come from an iReal Pro playlist imported as HTML
clicking the title line of the readout opens the chart picker: the import item, then each imported playlist, then its songs behind their initials
clicking the key line of the readout opens a list of the twelve keys, and choosing one transposes the whole chart; there is no transpose knob on the panel
clicking the plate below the key opens the chart window, and clicking it again closes it; the window shows the chart and follows the music
clicking a measure in the chart window moves the play head to the next time that bar comes round
dragging across measures in the chart window loops them, bracketed in orange, the same every time round; a click clears the loop
only a change of STYLE is followed. Opening a patch is not a change, so knobs turned after a style was chosen stay as they are
the BPM and SEED plates are stepped with the scroll wheel rather than dragged, and neither opens a list, because each covers more values than a menu holds
the three pitch outputs are ordinary voltages, so a quantiser, an oscillator or anything else in the rack can be patched to the harmony without an MPX module in between
an MPX cable carries a note stream rather than a voltage and goes to an MPX input; fromMPX turns a stream back into gates and pitch for the wider rack
menu: Import an iReal Pro playlist… — opens a file chooser for an iReal Pro playlist exported as HTML and adds its songs to the charts on offer
Charts — a heading over the import item and one entry per imported playlist, each opening onto its songs behind their initials
